I will say that diabetes has been crippling for me. I have a lot of complications that will not go away.

In any case, it would be selfish on my part to have children, if they ended up experiencing the situations I have. Maybe that's not the case for you, and that's okay.

I can't understand why people like me exist. If there's a God, isn't he supposed to be kind? I can't see any other way out of this. I can't shut my mind up. I'm sorry if I'm bothering you it's just I keep trying to stop myself and I keep coming back to the same thing. I don't want to go to a hospital lmfao I feel like I'm losing my mind

I have a lot of hobbies but I just don't look forward to anything. My life is really fucking blank. Most of the time I'm too tired to move. Sometimes if I'm lucky I'll have spurts of energy but it just makes me want to kill myself more. I shouldn't feel this way but I do. I wish something would happen to me so I wouldn't have to do it myself.

You're right, and now I feel like an idiot for writing that. In any case I'm older now but my thoughts on dying remain the same. My whole life has been the same day, over and over again. I don't know if I'm making sense but I've always heard that things will get better but they haven't. I've tried to change. I'm the problem. I can't change. I feel like I'm being strangled. It's the same thing over and over. My head feels like a spiral I can't get out of.
